content: {"doneWhen":{"all":[{"path":"body.x","op":"eq","value":11},{"path":"body.y","op":"eq","value":1}]},"modes":[{"id":"fight","priority":1,"when":{"path":"nearest(monster).dist","op":"lte","value":2},"steps":[{"macro":"press","params":{"button":"ControllerX","ms":100}}]},{"id":"flee","priority":2,"when":{"all":[{"path":"body.health","op":"lt","value":30},{"path":"nearest(monster).dist","op":"lte","value":1}]},"steps":[{"macro":"press","params":{"button":"DPadDown","ms":400}}]},{"id":"navigate","priority":3,"when":{"all":[{"path":"body.x","op":"neq","value":11},{"path":"body.y","op":"neq","value":1}]},"steps":[{"macro":"skill","params":{"name":"reach-ladder"}}]}],"skills":[{"name":"reach-ladder","skill":"async (b) => { const path = [[2,8],[3,8],[4,8],[5,8],[6,8],[7,8],[8,8],[9,8],[10,8],[11,8],[11,7],[11,6],[11,5],[11,4],[11,3],[11,2],[11,1]]; for (const [x,y] of path) { const ms = await b.monsters(); const danger = ms.some(m => Math.abs(m.x-x)<=1 && Math.abs(m.y-y)<=1); if (danger) { await b.press([{press:['ControllerX'],ms:100}]); } const r = await b.walkTo(x,y,'stand'); if (!r.ok) { b.log('walk fail '+x+','+y+' '+r.reason); } } return {ok:true}; }","check":"async (b) => { const p = await b.body(); return {ok: p.x===11 && p.y===1, detail: 'at '+p.x+','+p.y}; }"}]}
